question: Which NFA variant had the lowest first-cycle discharge capacity, and what was it?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%discharge capacity%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%mah g%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%first%cycle%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%first cycle%' ORDER BY page, id

SELECT id, figure_id, statement, value, unit, condition, panel FROM figure_facts WHERE figure_id IN ('p7.F4','p8.F5','p10.F7','p11.F8') OR statement ILIKE '%discharge%' OR statement ILIKE '%capacity%' ORDER BY figure_id, fact_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE page IN (8) AND kind='line' OR (page=8 AND id LIKE 'p8.L%') ORDER BY id
SELECT id, text FROM atoms WHERE id BETWEEN 'p10.L33' AND 'p10.L44' ORDER BY id
